name: Differentiable Quantization for Neural Fields
definition: Quantizes grid values to single bytes during optimization to reduce render-time memory, using a sigmoid to map to [0,1], quantization to byte, and affine mapping to [-m, m]. Uses straight-through estimator for gradients.
summary: Differentiable quantization compresses neural field grids into single bytes during optimization to reduce memory, avoiding quality loss by integrating quantization directly into training with per-component scaling.
